mapper.select: SELECT g.id AS goods_id, gi.image_url AS goods_image, g.send AS send, g.price AS goods_price, g.desc AS goods_description, g.state AS state, u.account AS user_account, u.head_url AS user_avatar, gh.look_num, gh.want_num FROM goods g JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, MIN(image_order) AS min_image_order FROM goods_images GROUP BY goods_id ) sub ON g.id = sub.goods_id JOIN goods_images gi ON g.id = gi.goods_id AND sub.min_image_order = gi.image_order JOIN user u ON g.seller = u.id JOIN goods_hot gh ON gh.goods_id=g.id WHERE ( SELECT pricategory_id FROM goods_category gc WHERE gc.goods_id = g.id AND g.state=2 ) = #{categoryId} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{skip}

select goods.id as goods_id, goods.seller as seller, user.head_url as seller_head, user.account as seller_account, goods.creat_time as creat_time, goods.desc as goods_desc, goods.price as goods_price, goods.freight as goods_freight, goods.stock as goods_stock, goods.`usage` as goods_usage, goods.send as goods_send, goods_hot.look_num as look_num, goods_hot.want_num as want_num from goods JOIN user ON goods.seller=user.id JOIN goods_hot ON goods.id=goods_hot.goods_id where goods.id=#{goodsId}

SELECT g.id as goods_id, g.desc as goods_desc, g.price as goods_price, g.creat_time, MAX(CASE WHEN gi.image_order = (SELECT MIN(image_order) FROM goods_images AS gi2 WHERE gi2.goods_id = gi.goods_id) THEN gi.image_url END) as goods_image FROM goods as g JOIN goods_images as gi ON gi.goods_id = g.id WHERE g.state=#{tag} and g.seller=#{userId} GROUP BY g.id;

SELECT g.id as goods_id, g.desc as goods_desc, g.price as goods_price, g.creat_time, MAX(CASE WHEN gi.image_order = (SELECT MIN(image_order) FROM goods_images AS gi2 WHERE gi2.goods_id = gi.goods_id) THEN gi.image_url END) as goods_image FROM goods as g JOIN goods_images as gi ON gi.goods_id = g.id WHERE g.id in ( SELECT goods_id FROM user_collection WHERE user_id=#{userId}) GROUP BY g.id;
